newsitem.title: USA: Versace murder prompts extra security at NY show.
newsitem.headline: Versace murder prompts extra security at NY show.

text.p: Organisers of this week's men's fashion show in New York are taking extra security precautions following the murder of Italian designer Gianni Versace, a security source said on Monday.
The source at the "Seventh on Sixth" collection of men's spring clothing declined to give details of the measures.
The show starts Monday with displays by Calvin Klein and continues on Tuesday, Thursday and Friday. It ends next Monday with a display by Ralph Lauren.
Versace was shot dead on the steps of his Miami mansion on July 15 by a lone gunman. Police are hunting for suspect Andrew Cunanan, who is also wanted in the killings of four other men since April.
